'''Uved Pledesin''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Lorrdian/Legends|Lorrdian]] from the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Lorrd/Legends|Lorrd]]. He was the [[Chief Justice]] of the [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances|Galactic Alliance]] [[Court of Justice]] as of [[43 ABY|43.5 ABY]]. Pledesin decided in ''[[The Galactic Federation of Free Alliances versus Tahiri Veila]]'' that the possession of a specific skill or knowledge was not enough to limit an individual's rights.
